أقرب النتائج

My Little Fort

Many children create small spaces of their own at home&mdash;under a table, behind cushions, or inside a blanket fort. In this hands-on activity, children build their own small &ldquo;fort&rdquo; using soft materials, shaping a space they can define and arrange. The session ends with a short story connected to the idea of shared spaces and home.

My Neighbor Totoro

A gentle and magical tale by Studio Ghibli that celebrates the innocence of childhood, the quiet beauty of nature, and the meaning of home found in family. Through the eyes of two sisters who move to the countryside, the story unfolds into a world of forest spirits and unseen friends.

On This Carpet

in Echoes of the Familiar Gallery, around every corner, a story unfolds. This workshop takes place on a carpet filled with familiar scenes, where everyday moments take shape through storytelling and creative exploration. Children move through these scenes, connecting details, building narratives, and expressing their ideas through drawing and simple story-making. Each visit brings together small moments into a larger picture, shaped by observation, memory, and imagination.

The House of Ideas

We begin with a simple question: Where do ideas live? Like us, ideas need a place where they feel safe in a space that inspires them and gives them room to grow. In this experience, we explore the House of Ideas: where we will see how a thought begins, what nurtures it and how we can create spaces that allow it to flourish. By designing a pop-up house inside a notebook, participants build a small, personal world where their ideas can live and take shape. Through cutting, folding and creating, a quiet reflection unfolds: what helps our ideas grow, and where do they truly belong

Unbox Your Story

What if we combine reality with fantasy? How would that enrich your story? Join us for a fun family experience as you discover a new world of stories full with boundless imagination and possibilities. All you have to do is open the box in front of you to reveal the tools and materials within. Begin creating your characters and designing your plot with the various elements available to you. Unleash your creativity and share your new story with those around you!

Mishkat Summer Camp

Discover the exciting world of science, energy, and innovation at Mishkat Summer Camp 2026, where young learners can explore the future through hands-on experiments, interactive challenges, educational games, and collaborative activities designed to inspire curiosity, creativity, and teamwork. Organised by Mishkat Interactive Center, an initiative of the King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (K.A.CARE), the camp introduces participants to the future of energy while developing STEAM skills through experiential learning. Activities explore topics such as solar, wind, and nuclear energy, hydrogen technologies, the circular carbon economy, artificial intelligence, innovation, and programming, supporting Saudi Vision 2030's goals of building future-ready generations. The programme is free of charge and is open to children aged 10–12 years. Camp Schedule Girls: 12–23 July | Boys: 26 July–6 August | Days: Sunday–Thursday Register Now
